title: DAMAGE GET OP LOT 受傷獲得OP物資
description: If you get damage, you will get a OP ITEM! 只要受到任何傷害就能獲得超强物品！
body:
每當你受到任何傷害，系統就會隨機給予你一件強力裝備或珍貴物品。摔落、火焰、怪物攻擊、溺水——任何傷害都算。附魔等級均為67

🎮 玩法說明

1.將數據包放入存檔的 datapacks/ 資料夾

2.進入遊戲後輸入 /reload

3.看到金色提示「傷害獎勵 已載入！」即代表成功

去受傷吧！每次血量下降，畫面上方就會出現你獲得的物品提示~

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/b-RIxd-nGPo" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

❓ 常見問題

Q：受傷後沒有收到物品？

A：確認版本為 1.21.5，並確認 /reload 後有看到載入提示訊息。

Q：可以和其他數據包一起使用嗎？

A：可以，只要其他數據包沒有使用相同的 scoreboard 名稱（dr.health、dr.prev_health、dr.roll）即可。

Q：多人遊戲可以用嗎？

A：可以，每位玩家受傷都會各自獲得隨機物品。


Whenever you take any damage, the system will randomly give you a powerful equipment or precious item. Falls, fire, monster attacks, drowning - any damage counts.Enchantment levels are all 67

🎮 How to play

1. Put the data package into the archived datapacks/ folder

2. Enter /reload after entering the game

3. When you see the golden prompt "Damage reward has been loaded!", it means success.

Go get hurt! Every time your blood volume drops, a reminder of the items you obtained will appear at the top of the screen~

❓ FAQ
Q: Didn’t receive the item after being injured?

A: Confirm that the version is 1.21.5, and confirm that you can see the loading prompt message after /reload.

Q: Can it be used with other data packages?

A: Yes, as long as no other packets use the same scoreboard name (dr.health, dr.prev_health, dr.roll).

Q: Can multiplayer games be used?

A: Yes, each player injured will receive random items.
